responsibility: Implements the AArch64-specific `llvm.aarch64.*` intrinsic surface for the Cranelift backend by lowering supported NEON and barrier operations into Cranelift IR, mostly through per-lane, horizontal, and reduction-style SIMD helpers. It owns the target-specific emulation and fallback reporting for unsupported AArch64 LLVM intrinsics before branching back to the caller’s continuation block.
